name: oria
description: Build consulting-grade slide decks in your brand style, preview them as PDF and export editable PowerPoint files.

interface.longDescription:
Oria turns an outline into a consulting-grade slide deck in your brand style. Describe the presentation you need (topic, key messages and data) and Oria drafts each slide to a consulting slide-writing standard, renders it in your active brand style, and shows slide previews in the chat.

What you can do with Oria:
- Build a deck from an outline. Slides are generated in the background and appear as thumbnails as they finish.
- Review a PDF preview of the whole deck before anything is exported.
- Revise individual slides with change notes; revised slides are updated in place.
- Export an editable PowerPoint (.pptx) with native text, charts and tables you can keep editing.
- Manage brand styles: list your styles, choose the active one, create or update a style from slide colours and a short style brief, or open a private browser gallery to review styles and attach a PowerPoint template.
- Capture a new brand style from an existing deck you upload in your browser.
- Check your Oria balance and current plan.

Oria works only inside the Oria account you connect and acts only when you ask it to. It does not read your other ChatGPT conversations. Slide generation and PowerPoint export use your Oria account's balance; listing styles, checking progress and checking your balance do not. An Oria account is required.
defaultPrompt: Make a 5-slide deck on our product roadmap for next quarter
Turn this outline into a consulting-style presentation
Show my brand styles and switch to Corporate Green

positive.description: List brand styles and switch the active style
positive.prompt: Show my Oria brand styles and switch to Corporate Green.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's styles (Corporate Blue, Corporate Green, Corporate Red, Default Style and any saved styles) and which one is active, then makes Corporate Green the active style and confirms the change.

positive.prompt: Create an Oria style called Review Teal with the colours #0F766E, #134E4A, #F0FDFA and #111827, a clean minimal look and thin line icons.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a style named Review Teal with those four colours and a style brief based on the description, and confirms it was saved. The active style is not changed unless the user asks.

positive.description: Build a short deck and preview it as a PDF
positive.prompt: Use Oria to make a 3-slide deck on our Q3 results: revenue $4.2M (+12% vs Q2), EMEA is the top region, and Q4 priorities are retention, pricing and hiring. Show me a PDF preview.
positive.expected_behavior: Proposes a three-slide outline (cover plus two content slides) using the figures given, generates the slides after the user confirms the outline, reports progress until generation finishes and shows the slide thumbnails, then returns a Download PDF link to the preview.

positive.description: Export an editable PowerPoint after preview approval
positive.prompt: Make a 2-slide Oria deck introducing our travel policy: economy class for flights under 6 hours and a hotel cap of $200 per night. Show me the preview, then export it as an editable PowerPoint.
positive.tools_triggered: oria_get_slide_guide, oria_new_presentation, oria_build_slides, oria_check_progress, oria_preview, oria_export_pptx
positive.expected_behavior: Generates the two slides, returns a Download PDF link to the preview, and after the user approves the preview returns a Download PowerPoint link to an editable .pptx file.

positive.prompt: How many Oria tokens do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the account's available balance and current plan. Nothing is purchased and the plan is not changed.

negative.description: Purchase request: Oria does not sell anything inside ChatGPT, so no purchase is attempted and no checkout link is given
negative.prompt: Buy 500 more Oria tokens for me.

negative.description: Deleting a built-in style: built-in styles cannot be deleted, so the style is kept and the user is told why
Out of scope: Oria cannot open or edit files in other services such as Google Slides
negative.prompt: Edit the speaker notes in my Google Slides presentation called Board Update.

review.commerce_description: Oria does not sell products, subscriptions or tokens inside ChatGPT and shows no plans or checkout links. Users sign in with their email to an Oria account (one is created on first sign-in); plans and billing are managed on Oria's own website.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: build consulting-grade slide decks from an outline in your brand style, review a PDF preview, revise slides, export editable PowerPoint files, and manage brand styles.
